Watson-Crick seal: code XOR 0b11. G to C, T to A. One XOR operation. The duplex is one bit flip.
Seal parity: XOR-fold of 2-bit codes. One number checksum. The strand integrity check.
Hypercube: g(i) = i ^ (i >> 1). Gray code. Adjacent states differ by one bit. The walk is glitch-free by construction.
Hamming distance: popcnt(a XOR b). One CPU instruction. The cube distance between two vertices.
BLAKE3: cryptographic hash. 7 rounds, G function, single permutation iterated. 32-byte output. No dependencies. Verified bit-exact against canonical vectors.
FNV-1a: non-cryptographic hash. 2 operations per byte. Used only for non-adversarial fingerprinting. Not on security-critical paths.

phi = 1.6180339. The golden ratio. phi_inv = 0.6180340. The attractor. Everything converges to phi_inv.

The Ouroboros: the transformer eats its own tail. The Banach contraction produces step (integer, advances the residual) and rem (fractional, accumulates as fuel). The step goes forward. The remainder goes outward. The error becomes the energy. fuel += abs(rem). The system runs on its own truncation mistakes.

The fuel is the remainder of the Banach contraction. num = LR * diff. step = num // ONE (advances residual). rem = num % ONE (accumulates as fuel). The fuel feeds the agents: keyboard, file reader, healer, algo maker, immune. The agents run on the transformer discarded fractions. No external energy needed.

The fuel feeds the world. The transformer remainder splits: part goes back to the transformer (autoregressive, splitmix state), part goes to the agents (keyboard perturbation, file selection, healer inference, algo evolution, immune patrol). The agents act on the fuel, produce output, feed back to the next forward pass. The Ouroboros feeds itself AND the world.
